# PhasmoSave Editor v1.0.0

The first public release of **PhasmoSave Editor** - a standalone Windows
application that edits your local Phasmophobia profile save file.

![release](https://img.shields.io/badge/release-v1.0.0-ember)
![tauri](https://img.shields.io/badge/tauri-v2-blue)
![rust](https://img.shields.io/badge/rust-stable-orange)
![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)

---

## What you get

| Asset | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `PhasmoSave-Editor_1.0.0_x64-setup.exe` | NSIS installer, installs for the current user |
| `phasmo-save-editor.exe` | portable build, runs without installing |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | checksums of both binaries |

The installer asks for no administrator rights and writes only to
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\PhasmoSave Editor`.

## Features

- **Automatic detection** of `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Kinetic Games\Phasmophobia\`,
  with a folder picker for non standard installations and a
  `PHASMO_SAVE_DIR` override for portable use.
- **Money** - direct entry, a fine tuned slider and quick presets
  (+10 000, +100 000, Max).
- **Level and experience** - set the level, set the progress inside the level
  and a small XP calculator on top.
- **Prestige** - prestige index from 0 to 3999, the reward multiplier and the
  prestige theme flag.
- **Equipment** - every piece of the kit with its quantity, tier 1 to 3
  unlocks and a one click *unlock all*.
- **Backup archive** - a timestamped backup is written before every change and
  can be restored with one click.
- **Dark, atmospheric interface** - frameless window, CRT scan lines,
  candlelit amber accents, tactile controls and spring animated numbers.

## Safety model

1. The game process is checked before every write; a write is refused while
   Phasmophobia is running.
2. A backup `SaveFile.txt.bak_<UTC timestamp>` is created **before** anything
   is changed.
3. The patched payload is parsed again and every patched field is verified.
4. The payload is encrypted, decrypted again and compared byte for byte. A
   container that cannot be read back is never written.
5. The file is replaced atomically through a temporary file in the same
   folder, so an interrupted write can never truncate the save.

## About the save format

The profile is an Easy Save 3 container:

```text
| IV (16 random bytes) | AES-128-CBC ciphertext (PKCS#7 padded) |
key = PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA1(password, salt = IV, iterations = 100, length = 16)
```

The decrypted payload is **not** valid JSON. Easy Save 3 emits bare integer
keys, key/value pair lists and split `Int64` values, so the editor ships its
own scanner. That scanner records the byte span of every node, and a
modification rewrites only the requested literal - the rest of the payload
stays byte for byte identical to what the game wrote.

## Requirements

- Windows 11 (Windows 10 works as well)
- WebView2 runtime - already present on any current Windows install
- Phasmophobia, if you want the editor to refuse writes while it is open

## Building from source

```bash
npm install
npm run tauri:build
```

Node.js 20+, a stable Rust toolchain and the Microsoft C++ build tools are
required. `cd src-tauri && cargo test` runs the test suite, including live
checks against a real save file when one is present.
